_comment_scope: Portal LHCI config. Per performance.md §1 portal pages are audited on MOBILE form factor (Lucia persona, simulated slow 4G, 4x CPU slowdown). H.2 replaced the `/` placeholder with the real home dashboard (HeroGreeting + ActionCards + MyRecentTickets + KbSuggestions); H.4 added the ticket-detail route. The bootstrap-fails-without-BFF condition that H.0 documented is unchanged — `staticDistDir` LHCI runs still surface the bootstrap error fallback rather than the route component. Timing thresholds therefore stay `warn` until MSW-in-LHCI lands (see `_comment_timing_thresholds`). Other routes stay listed under `_url_todo_phase_h` and graduate as feature chunks (H.3+) ship real content.
_comment_timing_thresholds: Numeric timing thresholds (TTI/LCP) remain `warn` post-H.4. Reason: `staticDistDir` LHCI runs without a BFF, so bootstrap fails at `/config HTTP 404` and LCP measures the bootstrap error fallback. Graduation to `error` requires the static dist to serve `/config` + `/me` (either via MSW-in-LHCI or a stub backend), tracked as an open item for the LHCI infrastructure work. CLS + accessibility + best-practices stay as `error` because they are robust to bootstrap state.

assert._comment_blocking: Blocking assertions — robust against the bootstrap state. CLS is structural (layout shift = bad regardless of backend). Accessibility + best-practices catch obvious regressions.
assert._comment_warn_only: Timing thresholds (TTI, LCP, score) stay `warn` until MSW or stub BFF is wired into CI LHCI runs. Values match performance.md §2 portal `/` mobile.
